canonical_name: Jordan canonical-form theorem family for finite complex matrices
literal_source_claim_zh: 复矩阵可相似于若尔当标准形
literal_source_claim_en: A complex matrix is similar to Jordan normal form.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not define Jordan blocks or Jordan normal form, fix the matrix dimension and index type, state the similarity witness or conjugation orientation, choose an ordering convention, say whether uniqueness is included, or settle degenerate cases. The inspected operator-and-Jordan-basis theorem is a strong source lead but is not cited by the catalog and requires an approved checked matrix transport. Selecting an exact proposition at intake would invent or substitute mathematics.
